description: This script retrieves version information from a version file or version control systems (git and hg). It determines the current revision or commit hash based on input parameters and repository state.

methods.name: try_version
methods.description: Attempts to get version from a local 'version' file.

methods.name: try_git
methods.description: Attempts to get version information from a git repository.

methods.name: try_hg
methods.description: Attempts to get version information from a Mercurial repository.
